title: Clean Markdown Web Extraction for AI Agent Context
oneLiner: Firecrawl converts entire websites into clean markdown or structured data, serving as a web extraction engine and MCP server to feed accurate context into AI agents.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Firecrawl converts entire websites into clean markdown or structured data, serving as a web extraction engine and MCP server to feed accurate context into AI agents.
requirements: Firecrawl API key or self-hosted instance
steps: Call the `/crawl` or `/scrape` endpoint with a target URL
Pass the markdown to an LLM for synthesis.
configSnippet: "Crawl <domain.com> up to depth 2, return only markdown, and exclude navigation/footer elements."
limitations: Rate limits apply on free tiers
complex JavaScript-rendered sites may require additional wait configurations.
